Minimum 5 years of research administration experience

items.item_text: Bachelo'rs degree and/or equivalent combination of education and experience
Minimum 5 years of research administration experience
Experience preparing, managing, and projecting budgets
Knowledge of and experience working with a variety of external sponsors, including federal and state agencies, private foundations, and industry sponsors
The Division of Experimental Medicine, within the Department of Medicine, is seeking a collaborative, detail-oriented Senior Research Administrator to support its research enterprise.

In this role, you'll provide full pre- and post-award research administration for faculty in the division. Working closely with the Department Chair, CAO, CFO, and other leaders, you'll manage a diverse portfolio of intra- and extramurally funded awards, from proposal development and award management to financial oversight, sponsor reporting, and compliance monitoring.

You'll support nearly a dozen investigators with active NIH F-, K-, and R-series grants and private foundation funding. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, juggles competing priorities with ease, and is passionate about advancing biomedical research through excellent research administration.
Close attention to detail in a fast-paced, fluctuating workload environment
Demonstrated proficiency with Adobe and Microsoft suite software, especially Excel
Interpersonal skills to effectively communicate information in a timely, professional manner
Strong organizational skills, ability to prioritize job functions, and handle multiple tasks simultaneously across multiple proposal submission systems
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with various stakeholders
Mathematical skills for preparing complex calculations and forecasts and identifying and resolving complicated financial scenarios
Ability to set priorities and complete ongoing tasks with competing deadlines, with frequent interruptions, to meet programmatic and financial needs
Organizational skills to create and maintain administrative and financial files effectively
Strong writing skills in a variety of styles to draft persuasive text for diverse audiences while ensuring adherence to funding sponsor guidelines
Demonstrated knowledge of effective grant funding processes, procedures, and techniques
Ability to perform complex financial analysis and customized reporting
Demonstrated ability to communicate medical, policy, and administrative information in  English
